name: Hévíz (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two horizontal bands, white over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Hévíz: a blue shield with a yellow griffin and a red water lily, between yellow branches, below the name HÉVÍZ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
